claim_verdicts.evidence: Docs: "Code in the OpenTofu language is stored in plain text files with the .tf or .tofu file extensions. There is also a JSON-based variant ... named with the .tf.json or .tofu.json file extensions." "OpenTofu evaluates all of the configuration files in a module, effectively treating the entire module as a single document. Separating various blocks into different files is purely for the convenience of readers and maintainers, and has no effect on the module's behavior."

Docs: "A resource block declares a resource of a given type (\"aws_instance\") with a given local name (\"web\")." "the resource type and name together serve as an identifier". "most of the arguments within the body of a resource block are specific to the selected resource type" plus meta-arguments (count, for_each, depends_on, lifecycle) defined by OpenTofu for all types. Address kind_cluster.this confirmed by outputs/stage-3/.../tofu-first-cluster.txt line 32. Lesson says which arguments a type accepts is defined by the provider: true for most, not all.
claim_verdicts.suggested_text: Arguments such as `name` and `node_image`, and what they mean, are defined by the provider for its type, not by OpenTofu.

claim_verdicts.evidence: Requirements page: "OpenTofu relies on plugins called 'providers' to interact with remote systems", "distributed separately from OpenTofu". Resource syntax page: "each resource type is implemented by a provider, which is a plugin for OpenTofu that offers a collection of resource types." Providers page: "Each provider adds a set of resource types and/or data sources that OpenTofu can manage."

Dependency lock file docs: the file .terraform.lock.hcl is stored "in your current working directory when you run OpenTofu" (root module folder, not in .terraform); records the selected version and checksums (h1:, zh:); "You should include this file in your version control repository". Repo: lock file beside .terraform/ with version = "0.11.0", constraints = "0.11.0", 7 hashes.

Docs: with a recorded selection, init "will always re-select that version for installation, even if a newer version has become available"; mismatch: "Error: Failed to install provider ... doesn't match any of the checksums previously recorded in the dependency lock file"; -upgrade: "disregard the existing selections and once again select the newest available version matching the version constraint."
Docs: with no existing selection OpenTofu will "select the newest available version that matches the given version constraint, and then update the lock file to include that selection."

Docs: "validates the configuration files in a directory, referring only to the configuration and not accessing any remote services such as remote state, provider APIs, etc."; checks syntax and internal consistency, "including correctness of attribute names and value types"; "Validation requires an initialized working directory with any referenced plugins and modules installed."

issues.text: Overstated: docs say "most of the arguments within the body of a resource block are specific to the selected resource type"; meta-arguments (count, for_each, depends_on, lifecycle) are accepted by every resource and defined by OpenTofu. "Which arguments a type accepts" reads as all of them.
issues.quote: Which arguments a type accepts, such as `name` and `node_image`, and what they mean, is defined by the provider, not by OpenTofu.
issues.fix: Write: "Arguments such as `name` and `node_image`, and what they mean, are defined by the provider for its type, not by OpenTofu." Update claim 2 text to match. Do not introduce meta-arguments (out of scope).

issues.text: The CI loop skips folders under `modules/` (find ... ! -path '*/modules/*'), and `deploy/tofu/modules/kind-cluster` and `modules/donhang-platform` hold `.tf` files. By the lesson's own definition (one folder of `.tf` files = one configuration) those are configuration folders that `init`/`validate` is not run in directly. Same wording in q6's explanation (en, vi).
issues.quote: then `init` and `validate` in every configuration folder under `deploy/tofu`
issues.fix: Write "then `init` and `validate` in each folder under `deploy/tofu/lessons` and `deploy/tofu/envs`" (the folders the loop selects at stage-3), and change q6 explanation 'correct' (en, vi) the same way. Do not introduce the term module.

issues.text: The tool is OpenTofu and the command is `tofu`, but the block is called `terraform`, the folder `.terraform` and the lock file `.terraform.lock.hcl`. Nothing says what 'terraform' is. I stopped and wondered whether a second tool is involved that I also need to install.
issues.fix: Add one sentence after 'The `terraform` block and the resource:' saying that `terraform` is simply the fixed name OpenTofu uses for the block holding settings about OpenTofu itself, and for `.terraform` and the lock file; no other tool is involved.

issues.fix: Add a clause saying in plain words which versions `~> 1.10.0` allows, and that this is an example of a version range.
